## Path of the Sword

Zoro promised Kuina he would become the greatest swordsman in the world. Promises like that take a lifetime.

Fight as a Swordsman and carry a sword.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Fight as a Swordsman](st_swordsman.md#q-26054de2b13db34f)

**Tasks**

- Carry a sword

**Rewards**

- Doriki +90, Belly +2,000, +5 Training Points (your style)

<a id="q-47261ca0ab691c2b"></a>

## Shi Shishi Sonson

A single draw, a single cut, and the sword is back in its sheath before the enemy falls.

Unlock Shi Shishi Sonson in your Swordsman tree. Swordsman trainers run Weapon Mastery trials that pay Training Points.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Path of the Sword](st_swordsman.md#q-4ed33b75ceee6f73)

**Tasks**

- Unlock Shi Shishi Sonson

**Rewards**

- Doriki +90, Belly +2,000, +6 Training Points (your style)

## The Black Blade

A blade soaked in Haki long enough turns black for good. Ryuma's Shusui was born that way.

Unlock Sanbyakurokuju Pound Ho, obtain a Supreme Grade blade and train Busoshoku Haki to 225, enough to blacken a blade.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [O Tatsumaki](st_swordsman.md#q-6fae513e6243ed9e)

**Tasks**

- Unlock Sanbyakurokuju Pound Ho
- Obtain a Supreme Grade blade
- Reach 225 Busoshoku Haki EXP

**Rewards**

- Doriki +540, Belly +60,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +12 Training Points (your style)

## The Oden Two-Sword Style

Kozuki Oden cut a dragon's scales with two swords and the Haki in them. His style guards from the front and boils over in the end.

Take up the Oden Two-Sword Style: find a master of the school (a mentor; sneak and talk to them) and be taken in. Only Swordsmen and Nitoryu fighters can join a sword school. The school teaches its techniques for nothing as your Doriki grows; the ability tree shows them, but only the school opens them.

**Prerequisites (any of)** — [Fight as a Swordsman](st_swordsman.md#q-26054de2b13db34f), [Fight with Two Swords](st_nitoryu.md#q-3ff5ff6bc4f977db)

**Tasks**

- Be taken into the Oden Two-Sword Style

**Rewards**

- Doriki +150, Belly +5,000
